_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Sluice/tools/make_shape.py. Every element was made for the Seraph Horizons mod. The frame (fr_*: the head box, the sluice box and its tail board, the concentrate launder under it, the trestles), the fitted parts (riffle_*: the riffles; infeedchute_* / tailingschute_* / concentratechute_*: vanilla's chute section, in and the two outputs; pipecopper_* / pipelead_*: the water inlet in each metal) and the concentrate drawn while the sluice runs (conc_*). The concentrate's texture code is 'concentrate', so a renderer can set it to the ore's. Keep element names when editing: the rig finds its parts by them.
